high_level_description: The image shows a square piece of artwork with a vibrant red background. The central focus is a stylized flower design. The flower has multiple layers of petals, with the outermost layer being a bright blue, followed by a layer of pink petals, and a smaller inner circle of pink petals. At the center of the flower is a dark purple or black circle, which contrasts sharply with the surrounding colors. Surrounding the main flower are several smaller floral elements, including buds and leaves.
